title: TaskList
description: Output of the decompose step: an epic's plan broken into buildable tasks (docs/work-board/PLAN.md, 'Planning pipeline', step 2). Every task is one context window of work for an executor model.

epic.description: The Plane work-item ID of the epic this task list belongs to.

tasks.description: The tasks, in the order they should be attempted.

id.description: A short kebab-case id, unique within the list. Other tasks name it in 'dependencies'.

title.description: One line: what the task delivers.

description.description: What to build and how, specific enough for an executor model with no other context: the goal, the approach, and the files to change.

files.description: Repo paths the task is likely to touch (files to create or edit). Empty when none are known.

dependencies.description: Ids of tasks that must be Done before this one can start. Must not reference this task's own id.

acceptance_check.description: A command or test name that must pass for the task to be Done, e.g. 'go test ./internal/fit/...' or 'TestFitChecksVRAM'. It must be runnable on the repo as-is after the change.

size.description: S or M only. Anything bigger is too large for one context window and must be split into smaller tasks.

executor_model.description: The registry id of the suggested executor model (one of the ids given in the prompt).
